notes:
Snapshot: mid-market B2B docs/search SaaS. Team: Head of Product (Lina Park), Backend Eng lead (Samir Bhat), Data Eng (4), ML Engineer (2). Current stack: Elasticsearch for inverted index, Redis for short-term cache, ad-hoc embedding jobs run in Airflow to Pinecone (trial).

POC goals:
- Validate Hosted API latency under realistic query mix (70% short chatty queries, 30% long context retrieval).
- End-to-end throughput target: sustained 200 qps for semantic search (retrieval + re-rank) at p95 < 300ms.
- Nightly batch embed job: 150k documents incremental/day; target wall time < 6 hours.
- Vector DB integration: compare Pinecone managed + Redwood hosted connector vs self-managed Weaviate/Milvus on GCP. Need connector patterns and failure-mode behavior.

Technical constraints and asks (from Diego/Samir):
- Must support 1536-dim & 768-dim embeddings; ability to upgrade model dims without major migration.
- Bulk embedding job needs resume-on-failure, chunked upload, and idempotent writes. Current Airflow DAGs are fragile under retries.
- Need clear guidance on batching sizes and recommended SDK usage to maximize throughput with minimal latency, and guidance for KV cache sizing to avoid repeated model calls.
- Data residency: EU subset of customers must keep embeddings in eu-west region; require proof of residency and audit log retention policy.

Quotes from calls:
- "We want performance parity with our current ES+Redis setup but better semantic recall — without doubling infra costs." — Lina Park (Head of Product)
- "If Dedicated can give predictable token/unit cost for high QPS, procurement will sign the contract." — CFO (procurement call).

POC deliverables committed:
- Integration guide (SDK + Airflow snippets) for bulk embedding push and incremental refreshs.
- Perf harness (locust scripts + sample dataset) and results dashboard.
- Pricing scenarios: Hosted incremental cost vs Dedicated reserved capacity break-even analysis at 200qps sustained.
- Compliance package: SOC2 summary + KMS config notes + residency checklist.

- Maya to send updated pricing scenarios + sample contract redlines.

- Focus messaging on batching strategies, autoscaling behavior for burst traffic, and connectors for Pinecone/Weaviate to ease migration.
